title: Chippokes Farm Museum

services.name: 4 cabins
services.desc: Four cabins are currently available for rental. There is a two day minimum stay required. The Spratley House was built in 1947. It is a reproduction colonial structure on the site of an earlier building. The front door enters into the living room. The bathroom and kitchen are also on the first floor. The stairs lead to the second floor where there are 2 bedrooms in what was once an open loft. One bedroom has a double bed. The other has a daybed with a trundle. services.name: Chippokes State Park Campground
services.desc: The campground, which has two loops, is open from the first Friday in March through the first Monday in December. All campers should check in at the office upon arrival. Those arriving after the office is closed will find check-in information at the entrance's contact station. Maximum occupancy per site is six
